title: Playing the Smart Set show; never traveling
summary: The band played for the traveling Smart Set show, but he never wanted to go on the road after marrying.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Did you ever play in the theatre? Yeah.
Yeah. We used to play the show, the Smart Set show. Smart Set show. Smart Set show. Smart Set, yeah.

That's a traveling musical show used to come out of New York, you know. And they'd come here and we'd play the show. Every time they'd come we'd play. They'd carry their own directors, you see, the piano player, you know.
What band was that then? Huh?
Piran. Did you ever play with any of these traveling circuses or anything? Circus?
Yeah. No, no. I never wanted to travel.
I don't know how Bunk used to play and all that.

At one time I had a, before I was married, when I was young, I had a mind to go on the road, you know, because I could have went, because I could double, you see, I could play violin and trumpet, you know. But I got married and that killed all of that, you see. That settled that too.
